pdfminer.header-footer:
Your Name

SUMMARY
Operations analyst with eight years of reporting, scheduling and process work in warehouse and retail settings. Builds 
weekly reports that managers use to plan staff and stock.

EXPERIENCE

Operations Analyst  |  Company A  |  Mar 2021 – Present
• Built a weekly staffing report used by 12 store managers to plan shifts.
• Cut late deliveries from 9% to 4% by changing the order of morning loading.
• Trained 6 new analysts on the reporting tools and the monthly close.

Inventory Coordinator  |  Company B  |  Jun 2018 – Feb 2021
• Counted and reconciled stock for two warehouses holding 3,000 product lines.
• Set up a cycle count schedule that ended the yearly full shutdown.
• Answered supplier questions on short shipments within one working day.

Sales Associate  |  Company C  |  Aug 2016 – May 2018
• Served about 80 customers a day at a busy downtown counter.
• Kept the returns log that the store manager used for weekly orders.
• Opened and closed the store alone on weekends.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Business Administration  |  University A  |  2016

SKILLS
Tools: Excel, SQL, Power BI, inventory systems
Languages: English, Spanish

your.name@example.com  |  (555) 010-0199  |  City, State
